dedupe_keys.name: coastal and marine habitat map of singapore nparks 2018 and 2010 2011 editions

description: The Coastal and Marine Habitat Map of Singapore 2018 from the National Parks Board is a high-resolution map of coastal and marine habitats made by pixel-based supervised classification of satellite imagery, bathymetry data and expert ground knowledge. It is published on the national open data portal as a GeoJSON download of about 67 megabytes, with polygon features carrying an object identifier, a habitat code and habitat type, and area and perimeter fields; the listing was last updated on 18 March 2026, and the portal offers a JSON preview and a change history. An earlier edition, the Coastal and Marine Habitat Map of Singapore 2010/2011, is also listed on the portal. The data is free under the Singapore Open Data Licence linked from the portal. Caveats: habitat classes come from image classification and may not match field conditions, and the page read does not list the classes. Coverage is Singapore's coast and territorial waters. It supports coastal flood and sea level rise adaptation analysis, such as nature-based protection with mangroves and seagrass in front of ports, roads and reclaimed land; related records are the New Zealand estuaries spatial database and the Korean Marine Environment Information Portal.
